s: Hi everyone, and welcome to Word Kitchen!
I am Lena, and this is Maya.
Today we talk about the city.
Our theme is cities and daily life.
I live on a quiet street.
The street near my house is small.
In the morning, I walk on that street to the bus stop.
A street is a road in a city.
Houses and shops stand on a street.
On my street there is a bakery and a small shop.
A shop is a place where you buy things.
I go to the shop every day.
I buy milk at the shop.
The shop near my house opens at eight.
The people in the shop are very friendly.
I love the shop on my street too.
A market is a big place with many small shops.
At the market, people sell fruit, vegetables, and fish.
I go to the market on Saturdays.
At the market you can also meet your friends.
A park is a green place with trees and grass.
Our city has a big park.
In the park there is a bench under every tree.
A bench is a long seat.
I sit on a bench and read a book.
In the morning, old people walk in the park.
The park is quiet and beautiful.
A bridge is a road over water.
Our city has a river, and there is a bridge over the river.
I walk over the bridge to work every day.
The bridge is old and beautiful.
At night the bridge has many lights.
From the bridge you can see the whole city.
A square is a big open place in the city.
Many cities have a square in the center.
In our square there is a fountain.
On Sundays there is music at the square.
A bakery is a shop with bread and cakes.
I love the bakery on my street.
The bakery smells so good in the morning.
At the bakery I buy warm bread.
The people at the bakery are always smiling.
A cinema is a place where you watch films.
Our cinema is near the square.
I go to the cinema with my friends on Fridays.
At the cinema we eat popcorn.
Traffic is many cars on the road.
In the morning there is a lot of traffic.
Because of the traffic, I take the bus.
In the evening the traffic is worse.
Big cities have big traffic, so I leave home early.
And when we are tired, we sit on a "bench".
A bench is a long seat in the park or on the street.
I like the bench near the fountain.
We sit on a bench and talk.
A bench is a good place to rest.
On a sunny day, the bench in the park is perfect.
Let us remember our ten words.
Street, shop, market, park, bridge, square, bakery, cinema, traffic, and bench.
Listen to the podcast, read the transcript, and say the words out loud.
See you next time on Word Kitchen!
